'''Baranj the Starseeker''' was a [[Evocii]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Rifle Grenadier and sharpshooter who lived on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He and a group of other Evocii had acquired a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], which was cause for alarm for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. [[Rhamm]], one of [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]'s foremen, tasked an individual with killing Baranj and his followers as well as destroying the starship.
